roadmap.title: Base campaign
roadmap.description: Play all 22 chapters on any difficulty. Collect Gold, Rubies, Wraithstones, toys, Codex pages, and Demonic Essences as you go. Pin Mission Challenges from Chapter 4 onward.

roadmap.title: Base campaign completion
roadmap.description: Replay chapters for missing collectibles and challenges. Buy the remaining upgrades, then finish the 11 weapon masteries; Chapter 20’s opening encounter is useful for farming.

roadmap.title: Revelations story
roadmap.description: Play Revelations in one save slot. Obtain the Chain Spear, collect the Relief pieces in Purgatory, and finish the story to complete the Master Key.

roadmap.title: Revelations endgame
roadmap.description: Use the Master Key to revisit purple areas. Finish relics, buy every spear upgrade, complete the four Classic Encounters, and earn the eight Astral Boss Key pieces before fighting Xal’Goroth.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chapter 1: Village of Khalim}.
Finish @loc{Chapter 3: Barrier Core}.

achievements.description: Finish The Holy City of Aratum, Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Finish The Holy City of Aratum, Chapter 5.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Holy City of Aratum}, Chapter 5.
Finish @loc{Chapter 14: Spire of Nerathul}.
Finish @loc{Chapter 19: Harbor of Souls}.
Finish @loc{Chapter 20: Resurrection}.

achievements.description: Defeat Enhanced Ahzrak and The Old One.
achievements.summary: Defeat Enhanced Ahzrak and The Old One.

steps.text: In @loc{Chapter 21: Final Battle}, defeat @enemy{The Old One}, then @enemy{Enhanced Ahzrak}.

achievements.description: Finish the base campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the base campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chapter 22: Reckoning} on any difficulty.
Finish @loc{Chapter 4: Sentinel Barracks} by defeating the @enemy{Vagary Champion}.
Finish @loc{Chapter 8: Abyssal Forest} by defeating the @enemy{Agaddon Hunter}.
Defeat the @enemy{Komodo Champion} in the opening battle of @loc{Chapter 14: Spire of Nerathul}.
Spend Gold on a weapon upgrade at a green @loc{Sentinel Shrine}.

achievements.description: Complete the Mastery Challenge for a single weapon.

steps.text: Buy every upgrade for the @item{Super Shotgun}, including its Wraithstone upgrade, at a Sentinel Shrine.
Open @mechanic{Challenges > Mastery} and pin Super Barrel Stuffer. Hit a demon with every pellet from 50 Super Shotgun shots; fire at large demons from close range.

achievements.description: Complete the Mastery Challenge for all weapons.
achievements.summary: Finish the Mastery Challenges for all 11 base-campaign weapons.

guide.context: Buy every upgrade for each weapon to unlock its mastery, including one Wraithstone upgrade per weapon. The Crossbow has no mastery. The final Wraithstone is in Chapter 22. Chapter 20’s opening leader cannot die until executed and keeps spawning ammo fodder, making it a useful farming arena.

collectibles.name: Combat Shotgun — Barrel Buster
collectibles.method: Land 150 shots with every pellet hitting a demon. Use point-blank shots against large demons; Damage to Demons at 50% lets them survive more hits.

collectibles.name: Super Shotgun — Super Barrel Stuffer
collectibles.method: Land 50 shots with every pellet hitting a demon. Shoot large demons from point-blank range.

collectibles.name: Shredder — Burster
collectibles.method: Damage demons 100 times with Pincushion or Ricochet secondary damage. With Pincushion equipped, shoot a large demon until it glows yellow, then throw the shield to trigger the explosion.

collectibles.name: Impaler — Acupuncture
collectibles.method: Refill melee charges 100 times with Lobotomy headshot bonuses. Spend melee charges first, then land headshots. Equip Chronospike and hold the aim control to slow time for easier headshots.

collectibles.name: Accelerator — Redline
collectibles.method: Deal Overload or Heatblast damage 1000 times. Equip Modulator and Mega Cell, then sustain fire until the weapon glows red and keep hitting demons.

collectibles.name: Cycler — Thermal Runaway
collectibles.method: Deal Overloaded or Lightning Arc damage 500 times. Shoot a large demon until it glows purple, kill it, then hit other demons while the Cycler fires red overloaded shots.

collectibles.name: Pulverizer — Hunter
collectibles.method: Deal Charged damage 250 times. Kill demons to build charge, then keep firing while the weapon glows yellow.

collectibles.name: Ravager — Gatherer
collectibles.method: Collect 100 ammo drops generated by Supplier. Equip Supplier and Ignition, sustain fire until the weapon glows blue, and stand close enough to collect the drops from damaged, unarmored demons.

collectibles.name: Chainshot — Reverberation
collectibles.method: Deal Cosmic Breach explosion damage 100 times with fully charged Reaver shots. Hold fire until fully charged, then shoot into groups.

collectibles.name: Grenade Launcher — Clusterfun
collectibles.method: Deal 100 instances of secondary Fragment or Cataclysm damage with cluster grenades. Keep firing at a large demon surrounded by smaller enemies.

collectibles.name: Rocket Launcher — Engorge
collectibles.method: Heal 50 times with Cannibalism from close-range rocket blasts. While below full health, parry a green attack, then shoot near your feet beside a demon before the perk expires.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Ballistic Force Crossbow} along the story route in @loc{Chapter 14: Spire of Nerathul}.

achievements.description: Acquire all shield upgrades under the base category.

steps.text: At a @loc{Sentinel Shrine}, spend Gold and Rubies to buy every upgrade in the @mechanic{Shield Base} category.
Finish the forge sequence in @loc{Chapter 9: Ancestral Forge} to receive @mechanic{Ground Fissure}.

achievements.description: Purchase every upgrade for one Shield Rune.
achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade for one Shield Rune.

steps.text: After receiving @mechanic{Ground Fissure} in Chapter 9, buy every upgrade for that rune at a @loc{Sentinel Shrine}.

achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade for all melee weapons.

steps.text: Obtain the @item{Dreadmace} during Chapter 15.
At Sentinel Shrines, buy every upgrade for the @item{Power Gauntlet}, @item{Flail}, and @item{Dreadmace} using Gold and Rubies.

achievements.description: Acquire all Shield Base, Shield Rune, and Melee Weapon upgrades.
achievements.summary: Purchase every melee weapon upgrade and every upgrade for Shield Base and Shield Runes.

guide.context: Gold pickups can only be collected once. Complete Mission Challenges and explore side paths for the remaining Gold and Rubies.

steps.text: At @loc{Sentinel Shrines}, buy all upgrades in Shield Base, all four Shield Runes, and all three melee weapons.

achievements.description: Acquire your first Demonic Essence upgrade.

steps.text: Defeat the Demonic Leader at the end of @loc{Chapter 2: Hebeth}.

achievements.description: Acquire all Demonic Essence ammo upgrades.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 12 Demonic Essence ammo upgrades in the base campaign.

guide.context: Use Chapter Select to recover missed leaders. After receiving an Essence, reach the next checkpoint before restarting; restarting too early can leave its collection counter at zero.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Hell Knight at a carrier engine
collectibles.location: Hell Knight at a carrier engine
collectibles.method: Defeat the Hell Knight leader guarding a carrier’s engine.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Northwestern Gore Portal
collectibles.method: Defeat the Mancubus leader at the northwestern Gore Portal.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Final forge encounter
collectibles.method: Defeat the Mancubus leader in the final combat encounter.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Gore Nest beyond the second Hell Cannon
collectibles.location: Gore Nest beyond the second Hell Cannon
collectibles.method: After destroying the second cannon, climb to the side arena and destroy its Gore Nest. Defeat the Revenant leader.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — First Dragon Landing Zone
collectibles.method: Land and defeat the Mancubus leader.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Revenant on the final tower approach
collectibles.location: Revenant on the final tower approach
collectibles.method: Defeat the Revenant leader on the story route before obtaining the Crossbow.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Leader guarding a relic objective
collectibles.method: Defeat the leader at the red encounter on the uphill route to a relic objective.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Leader in the large open story arena
collectibles.location: Leader in the large open story arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the leader on the main path.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Optional demon-arm encounter by the wreck
collectibles.location: Optional demon-arm encounter by the wreck
collectibles.method: After solving the wreck’s toy puzzle, leave the ship. In the next side room, strike the demon arm with Shield Charge and defeat the leader.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Leader beyond the red portal
collectibles.method: Go through the large red story portal and defeat the leader ahead.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Objective arena beyond the red spikes
collectibles.location: Objective arena beyond the red spikes
collectibles.method: Destroy the red spikes with the shield, drop into the next objective arena, and defeat its leader.

collectibles.name: Ammo Essence — Final leader encounter
collectibles.method: Defeat the final leader on the story route for the last Ammo upgrade.

achievements.description: Acquire all Demonic Essence armor upgrades.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 9 Demonic Essence armor upgrades in the base campaign.

guide.context: Use Chapter Select to recover missed leaders. After receiving an Essence, reach the next checkpoint before restarting; restarting too early can leave its collection counter at zero.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Mancubus beyond the broken bridge
collectibles.method: Defeat the Mancubus leader in the arena beyond the broken bridge.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Second main encounter
collectibles.method: Defeat the Pinky Rider leader in the second main combat encounter.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Second Hell Cannon arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the Mancubus leader before destroying the second Hell Cannon.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Slayer combat after the Atlan section
collectibles.location: Slayer combat after the Atlan section
collectibles.method: Defeat the Agaddon Hunter leader after leaving the Atlan.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Second Dragon Landing Zone
collectibles.method: Land and defeat the Revenant leader.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Optional Gore Nest reached through a launch ring
collectibles.location: Optional Gore Nest reached through a launch ring
collectibles.method: After the large gate fight, climb the wall and drop forward onto the lower platform. Use its launch ring, destroy the Gore Nest, and defeat the Hell Knight leader.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Other relic-objective leader
collectibles.method: Defeat the second leader guarding a main relic objective.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — First red combat encounter
collectibles.method: Defeat the leader in the first red encounter.

collectibles.name: Armor Essence — Final objective arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the leader in the last remaining red objective encounter for the final Armor upgrade.

achievements.description: Acquire all Demonic Essence Health upgrades.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 11 Demonic Essence health upgrades in the base campaign.

guide.context: Use Chapter Select to recover missed leaders. After receiving an Essence, reach the next checkpoint before restarting; restarting too early can leave its collection counter at zero.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Final leader
collectibles.method: Finish the chapter’s final battle by defeating its Demonic Leader.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Secret landing zone left of the four carriers
collectibles.location: Secret landing zone left of the four carriers
collectibles.method: Kill the Titan on the tower to reveal the landing zone. Land, destroy the tree, and defeat the leader that appears.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Northeastern swamp Gore Portal
collectibles.method: Defeat the leader at the northeastern swamp Gore Portal.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Final Hell Knight leader
collectibles.method: Defeat the Hell Knight leader in the final battle.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — First Ancestral Heart encounter
collectibles.method: Take the right path from the Ancestral Heart and defeat the Hell Knight leader.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — First Hell Cannon arena
collectibles.method: Defeat the Cyberdemon leader before destroying the first Hell Cannon.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Arena after the Ravager
collectibles.method: Defeat the Pinky Rider leader in the red encounter after collecting the Ravager.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Optional Gore Nest on an emitter route
collectibles.location: Optional Gore Nest on an emitter route
collectibles.method: Before leaving the descending emitter route, take the side path to the Gore Nest. Destroy the nest and defeat the Cyberdemon leader.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Main arena with the Cacodemon
collectibles.method: Defeat the Agaddon Hunter leader in this encounter.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — Arena after the Blue Skull
collectibles.method: Return from the Acolyte toy’s side area to the main arena and defeat the leader with a blue health symbol.

collectibles.name: Health Essence — First red combat encounter
collectibles.method: Defeat the opening leader for the last Health upgrade.

achievements.summary: Obtain all 32 Demonic Essence upgrades in the base campaign.

steps.text: Collect the 12 Ammo, 9 Armor, and 11 Health Demonic Essences from leader demons. Find the leaders in the @mechanic{Essential Health}, @mechanic{Essential Ammo}, and @mechanic{Essential Armor} checklists.

achievements.description: Complete all Mission Challenges in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Finish all 48 Mission Challenges in the base campaign.

guide.context: Pin the chapter’s challenges in the Challenges menu. Some appear after the needed weapon or rune is obtained. Progress carries into chapter replays; replay the chapter if you pass a required fight or leave a target behind.

collectibles.name: Rip and Tear
collectibles.method: Kill 40 demons.

collectibles.name: Plunderer
collectibles.method: Collect 150 Gold.

collectibles.name: Prize Fighter
collectibles.method: With three melee charges ready, land a full three-hit melee combo three times. Use a Hell Knight or Mancubus that can survive all three hits.

collectibles.name: Countercult
collectibles.method: Kill every cultist in the three ritual circles: the secret zone below the central carrier, the well on the right carrier, and the crate-access side room after the Super Shotgun.

collectibles.name: Layover
collectibles.method: Land at both secret Dragon Landing Zones: the tower with a Titan on the left of the open area, and the platform with two Titans below the central carrier.

collectibles.name: Cat and Mouse
collectibles.method: Chase and destroy three Hell Fighter ships while flying.

collectibles.name: Immovable Object
collectibles.method: Parry 10 Hell Knight attacks. The same Hell Knight can supply every parry.

collectibles.name: Unstoppable Force
collectibles.method: Hit demons 25 times with the Flail.

collectibles.name: Siege Breaker
collectibles.method: Destroy all four artillery cannons: the western side path, northeast of the northwestern Gore Portal, south of the northeastern Gore Portal, and near the swamp.

collectibles.name: Roundhouse
collectibles.method: Hit demons 10 times with fully charged Chainshot shots.

collectibles.name: Exterminator
collectibles.method: Kill at least three fodder demons with one shield throw on five occasions. Line up Imps, Zombies, or ordinary Soldiers.

collectibles.name: Ghost Buster
collectibles.method: Parry three green projectiles from Revenants.

collectibles.name: Knockout
collectibles.method: Finish five purple-glowing dazed demons with Shield Charge.

collectibles.name: Bone Collector
collectibles.method: Collect 100 ammo drops produced by melee hits. Spend ammo first so the drops can be collected.

collectibles.name: Nothing But Nade
collectibles.method: Land 10 direct Grenade Launcher hits.

collectibles.name: Sawed Off
collectibles.method: Keep demons pinned by the Shield Saw for 20 seconds in total.

collectibles.name: Seven Secrets
collectibles.method: Find seven secret areas.

collectibles.name: Rocket Man
collectibles.method: Damage at least five demons with one rocket on five occasions.

collectibles.name: Exterminator
collectibles.method: Destroy both Gore Nests. One is behind the Secret Key gate near the first cannon; the other is beyond the second cannon.

collectibles.name: Fault Line
collectibles.method: Affect 25 demons with Ground Fissure by parrying green attacks while the rune is equipped.

collectibles.name: Elusive
collectibles.method: Perform five Perfect Dodges while piloting the Atlan. Dodge just before a green attack lands.

collectibles.name: Dispersion
collectibles.method: As the Slayer, hit at least three demons with one Holy Swarm volley five times. Equip Holy Swarm and parry green attacks near groups.

collectibles.name: Crushinator
collectibles.method: During the Atlan section, hit at least two Titans with one Stomp. Wait until two horned Titans are close together and the attack gauge is at least half full.

collectibles.name: Punching Bag
collectibles.method: Hit Battleknights with melee attacks 10 times.

collectibles.name: Wait For It
collectibles.method: Kill 10 demons with explosive barrels.

collectibles.name: Skeleton Key
collectibles.method: Open both purple Secret Key doors: the Wraithstone room opposite the key’s vent route, and the toy room near the final arena.

collectibles.name: Deft Dragon
collectibles.method: Perform five Perfect Dodges on the dragon. Dodge just before green projectiles reach you.

collectibles.name: Veteran Pursuer
collectibles.method: Chase and destroy two Hell Fighter ships.

collectibles.name: Heart Harvester
collectibles.method: Kill both Demonic Essence leaders: the optional Gore Nest Cyberdemon on the emitter route and the Revenant on the final approach.

collectibles.name: Master Blaster
collectibles.method: Hit demons with 250 Auto Turret rounds. Equip Auto Turret and parry green attacks to activate it; equip the rune again if the story switches you to Heaven Splitter.

collectibles.name: Expert Stalker
collectibles.method: Chase and destroy two Hell Fighter ships.

collectibles.name: Heads Up
collectibles.method: Parry three Cacodemon green attacks.

collectibles.name: Face Cracker
collectibles.method: Damage 25 demons with the Dreadmace.

collectibles.name: Torrent
collectibles.method: Stun at least eight demons with one Heaven Splitter storm three times. Parry green attacks near groups with that rune equipped.

collectibles.name: Hunter
collectibles.method: Destroy all five wolf statues: the opening left path, the platform beyond the first pressure-plate secret, the Wraithstone cave, the cliff beside the relic route, and the final rotating dungeon.

collectibles.name: Roundup
collectibles.method: Kill at least 20 demons with one Ballistic Force Crossbow shot. Fire into a crowded red encounter.

collectibles.name: Swashbuckler
collectibles.method: Collect both Rubies and the Wraithstone. Take the Ruby on the opening lower route, the Ruby by the first portal, and the Wraithstone at the final shipwreck eye puzzle.

collectibles.name: Water Logged
collectibles.method: Find three underwater secrets: the hole between two blue lamps near the first portal, the right passage inside the submerged wreck, and the water route beneath the block in the two-gate puzzle room.

collectibles.name: Swallowed Whole
collectibles.method: Complete the optional stomach arena reached through the blue-symbol passage near the Commander Thira page.

collectibles.name: Toe-To-Toe
collectibles.method: Parry Cosmic Baron attacks 10 times. One Cosmic Baron can supply every parry.

collectibles.name: Berserker
collectibles.method: Kill 75 demons while Berserk is active. Pick up the red Berserk orb and farm the opening room with checkpoint restarts if needed.

collectibles.name: Dragon Hoard
collectibles.method: Open the three Gold chests: beneath the early Battleknight encounter, behind the graveyard breakable wall, and behind the wall past the moving-block rooms.

collectibles.name: Executioner
collectibles.method: Execute 25 demons by using the melee execution on purple-glowing dazed enemies.

collectibles.name: Cannon Crusher
collectibles.method: Destroy all three artillery cannons in the open battlefield.

collectibles.name: Extreme Prejudice
collectibles.method: Kill all three cultist circles: the four-wolf Wraithstone area, the cave beside the cannon-pit weapon skin, and the flooded underground room near the northern shrine.

collectibles.name: Master Hunter
collectibles.method: On the dragon route, pursue the Hell Fighter ship and shoot it down.

collectibles.name: Death Clock
collectibles.method: Kill two Cosmic Barons within five seconds. In the optional demon-arm arena after the Blue Skull gate, leave the first Baron alive until the second spawns, then fire the Crossbow at both.

collectibles.name: Thy Flesh Consumed
collectibles.method: Kill 25 demons within 10 seconds. Fire the Crossbow into the first arena’s opening wave or the final leader’s crowd.

achievements.summary: Collect all 24 demon toys in the base campaign.

guide.context: Chapter Select keeps collected toys and reveals the full map on replays. A missed toy can be recovered by replaying its chapter.

collectibles.name: Imp
collectibles.location: Blue-key side door near the church
collectibles.method: After taking the Blue Key, leave the church through the breakable wall. Return along the approach path and unlock the small blue-key door.

collectibles.name: Soldier
collectibles.location: Cave behind the Shredder drop pod
collectibles.method: Walk past the Shredder pod and drop onto the lower ledge leading into the cave.

collectibles.name: Imp Stalker
collectibles.location: Upper ledge in the early interior rooms
collectibles.method: In the room with two short staircases, climb both, turn around, and climb the ledge behind you. Drop into the hidden space and turn around.

collectibles.name: Hell Knight
collectibles.location: Breakable wall after the first Mancubus
collectibles.method: After defeating the first Mancubus, enter the building ahead. Break the wall on the left beside the Gold.

collectibles.name: Serrat
collectibles.location: Lower route outside the Super Shotgun carrier
collectibles.method: Leave the Imp-filled corridor toward the objective, then drop from the right edge outside. Follow the lower path, defeat the Mancubus, and climb through the opening it came from.

collectibles.name: Slayer
collectibles.location: Purple gate above the Sentinel Shrine
collectibles.method: Take the purple Secret Key south of the gate, then unlock the gate above the shrine.

collectibles.name: Mancubus
collectibles.location: Large statue near a Sentinel Shrine
collectibles.method: Look at the statue’s feet.

collectibles.name: Pinky Rider
collectibles.location: Upper route beyond the early turret section
collectibles.method: Climb the wall on the right. Throw the shield at the chain above to lower another climbable wall. Climb, turn around, and jump across to break the wooden wall; follow the path to the toy.

collectibles.name: Witch
collectibles.location: Caged toy near the second combat encounter
collectibles.method: After the fight, return toward the arena entrance and drop onto the side path. Throw the shield through the gap behind the cage to cut the orange chain, then hit the exposed blue gear.

collectibles.name: Vagary
collectibles.location: High platforms behind a purple gate
collectibles.method: Use the Secret Key from the breakable wall behind the first red combat encounter. Open the purple gate and climb the platforms to the Ruby and toy.

collectibles.name: Cyberdemon
collectibles.location: Floating platform beside the early courtyard
collectibles.method: After entering the courtyard beyond the opening battle, look over the outside ledge for a jump pad below. Drop onto the pad to reach the toy.

collectibles.name: Atlan
collectibles.method: After leaving the Atlan, turn around and walk up its arm to its head.

collectibles.name: Kreed Maykr
collectibles.location: Secret Key side room near the final arena
collectibles.method: Take the Yellow Key, open the elevator gate, and jump across the shaft. Turn around and break the vent cover with Shield Charge. Follow the vent, break out, and defeat the demons to obtain the purple Secret Key. After the final red combat encounter, return to the purple-key side room near the arena and unlock it.

collectibles.name: Arachnotron
collectibles.location: Breakable wall on the emitter route
collectibles.method: On the descending route toward the optional Gore Nest, break the wall on the left before going down.

collectibles.name: Revenant
collectibles.location: Tower ledge on the final approach
collectibles.method: Climb the tower and use its jump pad. From the landing ledge, turn around and jump to the ledge marked by armor shards.

collectibles.name: Agaddon Hunter
collectibles.location: Bramble wall in the starting room
collectibles.method: When the route returns to the starting room near the end, break the bramble immediately to the right of the doorway.

collectibles.name: Battle Knight
collectibles.method: Stand on the pressure plate above the toy area. Throw the shield at the exposed red chain across the gap, then drop to the opened toy door.

collectibles.name: Cacodemon Hybrid
collectibles.method: Move the block holding the toy before breaking out of the wreck. Leave through the entrance, line up the eye with the block, and throw the shield through the eye to open the toy’s enclosure.

collectibles.name: Komodo
collectibles.method: Near the Commander Thira page, drop from the ledge and hit the blue symbol on the right with the shield. Enter, drop through the hole behind the Gold, and win the encounter.

collectibles.name: Acolyte
collectibles.method: After taking the Blue Skull, drop behind it, turn left, and climb the wall ahead. Open the blue-skull gate on the right.

collectibles.name: Cosmic Baron
collectibles.method: Take the Yellow Key, drop from its ledge, and unlock the yellow gate on the right.

collectibles.name: Maykr Drone
collectibles.location: Underground area near the northern shrine
collectibles.method: Near the northern Sentinel Shrine, use the switch beside the round floor hatch. Drop inside and climb one wall. Hit the blue symbol with the shield, then go through the opened gate and turn right.

collectibles.name: The Old One
collectibles.location: Optional arena after the Blue Skull gate
collectibles.method: Open the Blue Skull gate and drop down. Turn around into the side arena and shield-bash the demon arm. Defeat the waves to reach the toy.

collectibles.name: Ahzrak
collectibles.location: Secret Key room beneath the first arena
collectibles.method: Get the purple Secret Key later in the chapter. Use the nearby purple door to return to the first large arena, then open the purple gate on the left and drop through the hole.

achievements.summary: Collect all 26 Codex Lore pages in the base campaign.

guide.context: Missing pages remain available through Chapter Select. The orange floating pages appear as paper icons on the map.

collectibles.name: Doom Slayer
collectibles.method: After closing the portal at the cliff’s base, climb the path on its right to the top.

collectibles.name: Village of Khalim
collectibles.location: Wall past the final arena’s burning wreckage
collectibles.method: After closing all four portals and clearing the next fight, climb the wall on the right past the wreckage.

collectibles.name: Hebeth
collectibles.method: In the room after the Imp Stalker toy’s hiding place, drop to the lower floor, climb the short stairs, and go through the doorway. Climb over the crate on the left.

collectibles.name: Sentinel Barracks
collectibles.location: Left of the ramp to the final gate
collectibles.method: Near the chapter’s end, look left at the bottom of the ramp toward the large gate.

collectibles.name: The Holy City of Aratum
collectibles.location: Cultist side room on the Super Shotgun carrier
collectibles.method: After the Super Shotgun, enter the side doorway from the Imp-filled corridor. Cut the chain, push the crate, and climb it to the cultist circle. Take the stairs beyond the circle.

collectibles.name: Deag Loric
collectibles.method: At the carrier where the Cycler is obtained, drop into the engine room and turn around before destroying the engine.

collectibles.name: Siege – Part 1
collectibles.location: Cliff west of the northwestern Gore Portal
collectibles.method: Climb the metal beam and rocks outside the cave to reach the page on the cliff.

collectibles.name: Kreed Maykr
collectibles.method: Drop onto the ledge below the statue’s left side to reach the page.

collectibles.name: Siege – Part 2
collectibles.location: Upper-right purple gate in the dining-room area
collectibles.method: Break the wall on the upper floor and follow the outside jump-pad route to the purple Secret Key. Return to the main room, unlock its upper-right purple gate, and follow the passage.

collectibles.name: Abyssal Forest
collectibles.location: Bramble wall after the shielded soldiers
collectibles.method: Break the bramble beside the path after the group of five shielded demons.

collectibles.name: Ancestral Forge
collectibles.location: Northwestern ledge before the second heart encounter
collectibles.method: Before climbing toward the second red combat encounter, go into the upper-left corner and drop onto the ledge.

collectibles.name: King Novik
collectibles.location: Upper platform reached from blue gear and green bodies
collectibles.method: In the later forge platform area, cut the orange chain overhead. Jump across and hit the blue gear to lift the platform. Jump to the released ledge, then use the two green bodies to reach the page.

collectibles.name: The Forsaken Plains
collectibles.location: Room on the right-side shrine route
collectibles.method: From the shrine on the right of the map, follow the route through the demon-filled room and drop into the next room.

collectibles.name: Prince Ahzrak
collectibles.location: Purple Secret Key room near the center
collectibles.method: Use the green body beside the Secret Key’s cage to reach the key from above. Open the purple gate near the center, above the stairs.

collectibles.name: Sentinel Command Station
collectibles.location: Hole to the right after the first vent
collectibles.method: After leaving the opening ventilation shaft, continue forward past the left turn and enter the hole on the right.

collectibles.name: Spire of Nerathul
collectibles.method: After the optional Gore Nest on the emitter route, cross the fallen pillar. Turn left by the green body and drop onto the lower ledge.

collectibles.name: Serrat
collectibles.method: Take the page beside the route just before the elevator at the chapter’s end.

collectibles.name: City of Ry’uul
collectibles.location: Lower ledge opposite a green body
collectibles.method: After the point-of-no-return gate, cross the gap, use the jump pad, and climb the stairs. Turn right before using the green body, drop to the Gold ledge, and climb its wall.

collectibles.name: The Witch
collectibles.location: Gate near the first enemy spawn
collectibles.method: From the start, jump to the small platform on the right. Turn left and throw the shield through the wall opening at the blue eye, then return to the gate near the first enemies.

collectibles.name: Temple of Lomarith
collectibles.location: Side passage inside the underwater wreck
collectibles.method: After the first large green portal, swim into the wreck marked by armor pickups. Take the right passage before swimming out.

collectibles.name: Commander Thira
collectibles.method: After the large hallway battle, look across from the third organ section before destroying it.

collectibles.name: Harbor of Souls
collectibles.method: After crossing the bridge, drop left instead of following the main path. Jump across from the Gold ledge to the page.

collectibles.name: Hell Priests
collectibles.location: Behind bars beyond the movable block
collectibles.method: Use the movable block to climb the wall. When the page appears behind bars on the right, follow the left path around to the back.

collectibles.name: Resurrection
collectibles.method: Take the Yellow Key, drop from its ledge, and open the yellow gate on the right.

collectibles.name: Commander Valen
collectibles.method: After the sequence that destroys the spaceship and lands you on it, turn around before entering the ship.

collectibles.name: Marok
collectibles.method: Break through the first wall and drop from the ledge. Take the page on the right.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Uprising}, the final story region of Revelations.
Finish @loc{Osseus}, return to @loc{Purgatory}, and continue the story after inserting the third Ascension Stone.
Finish Proving Grounds and follow the story in @loc{Purgatory} to receive the @item{Chain Spear}.

achievements.description: Acquire all upgrades for a single Chain Spear ability.
achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade for one Chain Spear ability.

steps.text: Finish Revelations to complete the @item{Master Key} and enter the purple endgame areas for Blood Iron.
At a shrine, use Platinum and Blood Iron to finish one of the five Chain Spear ability branches. The Base branch does not count.

achievements.description: Acquire all Chain Spear upgrades in a single save slot.
achievements.summary: Purchase every Chain Spear upgrade in one save slot.

steps.text: Finish Revelations and use the completed @item{Master Key} to explore the purple endgame areas.
Collect @item{3050 Platinum} and @item{1275 Blood Iron} in total for the spear. Gather pickups, finish relics, and complete endgame challenges for currency.
Buy every Chain Spear upgrade at shrines in the same save slot, including all five ability branches and Base upgrades.

achievements.summary: Reassemble a relic made from five pieces.

steps.text: After Hell’s Core, go to the three-ring symbol puzzle on the left side of @loc{Purgatory}. Throw the shield at the blue gears to rotate the rings. Set the symbols from top to bottom to @mechanic{II, triangle, X}, then use the portal and take the piece.
From that piece’s platform, return toward the jump-off point. Follow the armor trail on the right and use the Chain Spear hook to reach the second piece.
Return to the symbol puzzle. Set @mechanic{II, X, II}, use the portal, and collect the third piece. Then set @mechanic{X, X, II} and take the fourth piece through that portal.
Break the ice wall near the Hell’s Core portal, then pull the lever behind it. Use the shield to rotate the launch pads and the spear to reach the fifth piece.

achievements.description: Completely reassemble all Relics in a single save slot.
achievements.summary: Reassemble every relic in one save slot.

guide.context: Finish Revelations to complete the Master Key before collecting the endgame relics. Keep every relic in the same save slot.

collectibles.name: Relief
collectibles.location: Symbol portals and ice-wall launch pads
collectibles.method: Collect the five pieces using the Some Assembly Required instructions.

collectibles.name: Idol
collectibles.method: Take one piece on the tower’s left side and the other on the lower floor.

collectibles.name: Beast
collectibles.method: Take the piece near the Hollow Shrine. Melt the ice wall opposite the shrine with the incinerator for another. After the Revenant fight, pull the green switch on the right and use the jump pad beyond the opened gate for the third.

collectibles.name: Mask
collectibles.method: Take the first piece near the edge after the second launch disc. Before the third disc, jump to the triangular platform on the left and hit the floating cube’s blue gear to build a bridge to the other piece.

collectibles.name: Diary
collectibles.method: After the last disc launches you into water, surface and turn left for one piece. Find another left of the oval gate. On the right, climb the pillars and double-dash across the columns for the last.

collectibles.name: Angel
collectibles.method: Collect the two pieces on opposite sides of the highest floor. Cut the overhead chain on the left for another. Ride the moving side pillars to the top for the fourth.

collectibles.name: Sword
collectibles.location: Castle’s blue room and upper routes
collectibles.method: Take the piece behind the cage in the first blue room. Leave and follow the green body on the right to the three Hell Knights for another. Take the piece by the blue-flame gate, then follow the right-side path while heading for the next skull for the fourth.

collectibles.name: Urn
collectibles.method: Take the first piece after opening the blue/red door and the second farther ahead. After the catacomb fight, check behind the newly available climbable wall for the third.

collectibles.name: Dagger
collectibles.location: Room after the second Hollow Shrine
collectibles.method: Take both pieces in this room; the second is on the left.

collectibles.name: Axe
collectibles.method: Take the first piece after fighting the Titan. Turn left and cut the chain, then spear the green lever on the right. Take one piece on each side beyond the opened gate.

collectibles.name: Shield
collectibles.location: Master Key area opposite the Classic Encounter
collectibles.method: Collect one piece from the main room. Reach the second via the flying hook beside the climbable wall. Break the wall at the bottom for the third.

collectibles.name: Reliquary
collectibles.location: Master Key area via the red-key room
collectibles.method: Enter an orange portal from the red-key room and clear the endgame area. Hit the blue gear with the shield and jump beneath the bridge it creates for one piece. Climb the wall and jump back toward the left platform for the second.

collectibles.name: Amphora
collectibles.location: Area containing the Ritual of Power
collectibles.method: Use the flying hooks to reach both upper sides for the first two pieces. Use a hook again for the third, then take the fourth in front of the Gore Nest.

collectibles.name: Chalice
collectibles.location: Tunnel below the first endgame area
collectibles.method: Follow the tunnel past the mission-marked hole and look overhead for a green body; use it to reach the first piece. Take the second piece to the left of the Classic Encounter.

steps.text: After finishing Revelations, use the @item{Master Key} to enter the purple endgame area in @loc{Hell’s Core}, opposite the Classic Encounter.
Start the @mechanic{Ritual of Power} and finish its timed combat challenge. Any medal is enough for this achievement.

guide.context: In Chasm of Xal’Goroth, enter the Classic Encounter only once per visit to the region. Re-entering during the same visit can trap the save; reload the region before another attempt.

steps.text: Finish Revelations and use the @item{Master Key} to open the endgame areas.

Complete the @mechanic{Classic Encounter} in each region: Hell’s Core near the Hell Battery; Chasm of Xal’Goroth via the main-room blue gear; Osseus at the end of its first endgame area; and Uprising in its first endgame area. Collect one shotgun piece from each.
Finish Revelations to complete the @item{Master Key}. Use the key to enter the purple endgame areas in Hell’s Core, Chasm of Xal’Goroth, Osseus, and Uprising.
Collect all @item{eight Astral Boss Key fragments}: earn gold in the Ritual of Power and finish the Praetor Challenge in each of Hell’s Core, Chasm of Xal’Goroth, Osseus, and Uprising.
Return to @loc{Purgatory}. Use the completed key at the gate in the tunnel beneath the central hub, then defeat @enemy{Xal’Goroth the Imprisoned}.
When the boss moves to the arena’s side, throw the shield at the blue gear exposed during its attack. Watch the gaps in the floor after the first phase.
